Sets the value that a parameter of an effect gets when the scene is applied. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
Include "<audio.bb>"
AudioSceneParam cave, reverb, BB_EFFECTPARAM_MIX, 0.6
AudioSceneParam cave, reverb, BB_EFFECTPARAM_SIZE, 0.8
```
@param scene  A scene from [CreateAudioScene](CreateAudioScene). Anything else is a runtime error.
@param effect  An effect from [AddAudioEffect](AddAudioEffect) or [AddChannelEffect](AddChannelEffect). Anything else is a runtime error.
@param param  A parameter the effect has, as for [AudioEffectParam](AudioEffectParam).
@param value  As for [AudioEffectParam](AudioEffectParam). A value outside the range of the parameter is a runtime error.
@gap [BlendAudioScene](BlendAudioScene) mixes a value that only one scene holds with what the effect started with. When an effect is freed, every scene forgets it.
